lines: Kotaro
ーAs if I'd let you, old dude!!!
Hrm!?
*Clang!!*
Me (Kirara)
F-, Fuma!?
I let out a short scream.
The man who had surprise-attacked us was clearly a Taimanin.
When that powerful arm came hurtling toward me as I lay on the ground, the boy who was my junior, Fuma Kotaro, stepped up to protect me.
Kotaro
Y-You bastard...! That's some crazy strength...
Me
Kotaro was clearly in a miserable state.
Although he had avoided a direct hit by guarding with his arm, the arm he had used was now broken and bending the wrong way.
Me
F-Fuma...? Your arm...
Perhaps because my internal organs had been damaged, squeezing out even those few words was excruciating.
But Kotaro's injury looked just about as horrible as mine.
Kotaro
Eh...? Yeah... But it's not as bad as your injuries, senpai...
He said it with a grin and stood in front to protect me.
Kotaro
Anyway, please just lie there, senpai. ーI'll take care of him somehow.
Me
I opened my eyes wide.
ーFor me, men were "enemies" who had used and harmed me and my mother.
However, this Fuma Kotaro was protecting me even while sustaining these wounds...
Me
With a sense of disbelief, I stared at "him," at his back, as he stood there to protect me.
Me (Kotaro)
Anyway, please just lie there, senpai. ーI'll take care of him somehow.
Me
(...That being said, this is going to be tough...)
I grumbled in my head as I held my ninjato in my uninjured hand.
I had said that to Kirara-senpai so she would take a quick rest, but my injuries were also pretty bad.
I had no time to prepare a plan as I would normally.
Besidesーthe problem was my opponent.
GUHUHUH... Well, well, Young Lord, chancing upon you here was unexpected.
Me
Yeah... It's been a while, Yaguruma Yaemon.
The giant looked down at the wounded two of us and his face contorted into a grin.
Yaguruma Yaemon, an underboss of the Nisha Clan.
He used a superhuman Ninja Art, the Camouflage Jutsu "Metaphysical Mimicry."
It was said to allow him to become one with any inorganic substances other than water and to use them to his advantage.
For example, when he had done his surprise attack on Kirara-senpai just now, he had become one with the earth.
And then he had created a puppet that looked exactly like him, controlling it to attack his enemy.
Metaphysical Mimicry, the superb concealment technique, and his well-trained herculean strengthー
Maybe not as strong as Bikuni and Shonosuke, but this man too, was a mighty Taimanin beyond compare.
Yaguruma Yaemon
Oh my, the world really is a curious place.
Yaemon
I never thought that my humdrum duty of taking care of the witch would lead to such a big catch falling into my lap!
Me
...By big catch, do you mean me?
In order to buy at least a little time, I opened my mouth.
Yaemon
That is correct. It would seem, Young Lord Diot, that you are weighing heavily on Gaiza-sama's mindー
Yaemon
So I shall pluck your arms and legs, Young Lord, and present them to him as ornaments, GUHUHUH...
Me
Hehe, very funny...
He most likely wasn't joking, of course.
These guys would do something like that without hesitation. That was what it meant to be a ninja.
Me
...But Yaemon. Why is someone from the Nisha Clan like you here? Did Gaiza join forces with the witch?
Yaemon
GUHUHUHUHUHUHUHー!!!
When I continued questioning him, Yaemon laughed loudly and held his sidesー
Yaemon
Why don't you ask him that yourself!? After you become a limbless daruma, that isー!!
Me
Ugh!!!
Yaemon attackedー
I let out a groan and somehow repelled the attack from the huge arm with my ninjato.
*Claaaaang!!!*
Yaemon
Ooohhh!? What a surprise!! The powerless Young Lord held out against one of my attacksー!!
Me
Yeah. This much is no problem...
That was a lie.
Even if I had become able to hold my own in combat after my resurrection, that was only against lower demonic creatures like those Will-o'-wisps.
I couldn't possibly directly contend with an underboss from the Nisha Clan.
Me
(Damn it...!! I'd somehow like to buy enough time for Kirara-senpai to be able to run away...)
Yaemon
GUHUHUH!! How delightful!! Then I'll also make sure to put a bit more effort into playing with you!!
Yaemon's fist swung down on me like a hurricane.
His attacks did not stop no matter how much I defendedーrather, they became even fiercer.
Me
Ugh... damn iiiiit!!
The difference in strength was hopeless.
Every blow pushed me further back.
And then, as I dug my heels in, desperately attempting to hold on a little longerー
Yaemon
Looky here, got you!! You did your best, but you are just the Young Lord Diot after all!
Me
Arrgh!? D-Damn it...
It was frustrating, but Yaemon was right.
The moment I was cornered and the pain from my injured arm slowed my movements,
I was quickly pinned down by Yaemon's powerful arm.
Yaemon
Well then, now it's time for the fun part! I'll pluck the appendages off the rascally Young Lord and make him all adorable and obedient!
Me
Yaemon's giant palm grasped my uninjured arm.
With a creaking sound, my shoulder was dislocated and my arm was stretched outー
Me
Arrgh!? Uaaaaaaaaaaaaaarrrrrrrrgghhhh!!!!
Yaemon
GUHUHUH!! What's this, Young Lord!? If you make too much of a fuss, I'll pluck out that noisy tongue of yours too!!
ーEverything before me went dark from the intense pain.
It was true that I had apparently gained some sort of regenerative power.
But would it work even after having my arms and legs pulled off?
And just when such an idiotic thought crossed my mind...
HAAAAAaaaaー!!!
ー*Claaang!!!*
Yaemon
What!? Impossibleー
Having been attacked with his guard down, Yaemon jumped back in a flash.
I was thrown to the ground violently, and when I looked up in a dazeーI saw her.
Kirara
...Thank you, Fuma. Thanks to you, I'm able to move a bit again...
Me
Kirara-senpaiー!?
Breathing unevenly, and with blood spilling from the edges of her lips, Kirara-senpai held up her icy claws.
Protecting me from the smirking Yaemon, she stood resolutely.
Me
(W-Wait...!? But Kirara-senpai's body is...!?)
Yaemon
Ohoh!? You surprised me!! Little lady, all throughout your body, your internal organs should have been smashed and turned to pulpー
Yaemon
Why are you still able to move?
Kirara
Hmph! Don't lump me in with normal humans!
Kirara
I have my mom's bloodーthe blood of the proud Oni running through my veins!!
Me
I was taken aback... but, with that info, some things made sense too.
When it came to the Oni, their exceptional toughness and ability to recover were famous.
Yaemon
Ohoh!? So you're half Oni!? I heard about that, I thinkー
Yaemon
A Taimanin father killed the Oni mother who bore his child. So you're that pitiable child, little lady?
Kirara
Shut up!!! Only I get to decide if I'm pitiable or not!!
Me
(Kirara-senpaiー)
She's just an unpleasant, nasty senpai... who only says mean things... that's how I had been thinking of her.
But that had not been the case. She wasー
Yaemon
GUHUHUHUH!! How curious! I'm going to make this mongrel Oni-girl my favorite concubine, no matter what!!!
Yaemon laughed loudly and drew a symbol in the air, and thenー
As if sprouting out of the ground, countless Yaemons appeared one after another.
They were Yaemon puppets made from lumps of earth with his Ninja Art.
Kirara
ーBring it on then!! I'm going to smash you to pieces, so come at me all at once!!
